_source: Curated from 4D's own localized-constants XLIFF corpus (4D_ConstantsEN.xlf / 4D_ConstantsThemesEN.xlf, user-provided, parsed into references/4d-constants-registry.json). Each entry here is a hand-picked subset of one XLIFF theme group, scoped to exactly the constants a given command's docs actually document, not the group's full raw contents (a raw XLIFF theme group commonly bundles several logically-distinct constant lists together -- see 4d-constants-registry.json's module docstring). Referenced from command overlays via {"kind":"enum_ref","enum":"<key>"}; a final corpus-assembly step is expected to merge these into the root IR document's top-level "enums" map alongside references/4d-command-ir-examples.json's own enums.

WebServerOptionSelector.description: WEB SET OPTION / WEB GET OPTION selector constants (XLIFF theme group 73, 'Web Server'). Selects which Web server setting is read/modified; the value parameter's expected type/range depends on which of these is passed.

values.name: Web port ID
values.description: Integer: TCP port the Web server listens on.

values.name: Web IP address to listen
values.description: Text: IP address the Web server listens on.

values.name: Web character set
values.description: Integer: character set used by the Web server.

values.name: Web max concurrent processes
values.description: Integer: maximum number of concurrent Web processes.

values.name: Web maximum requests size
values.description: Integer: maximum size (bytes) accepted for incoming requests.

values.name: Web log recording
values.description: Boolean/Integer: enables/disables Web server log recording.

values.name: Web HTTPS port ID
values.description: Integer: TCP port the Web server listens on for HTTPS.

values.name: Web HTTP compression level
values.description: Integer: HTTP response compression level.

values.name: Web HTTP compression threshold
values.description: Integer: minimum response size (bytes) before compression is applied.

values.name: Web legacy session
values.description: Boolean/Integer: enables legacy Web session behavior.

values.name: Web max sessions
values.description: Integer: maximum number of concurrent Web sessions.

values.name: Web inactive session timeout
values.description: Integer: inactive-session timeout.

values.name: Web session cookie name
values.description: Text: name used for the Web session cookie.

values.name: Web inactive process timeout
values.description: Integer: inactive-process timeout.

values.name: Web session cookie domain
values.description: Text: domain attribute of the Web session cookie.

values.name: Web session cookie path
values.description: Text: path attribute of the Web session cookie.

values.name: Web session enable IP address validation
values.description: Boolean: enables IP-address validation for Web sessions. (Doc prose word order differs slightly from the XLIFF constant name 'Web session IP address validation enabled'; same constant, value 83.)

values.name: Web debug log
values.description: Integer, one of the WebDebugLogLevel enum values (wdl ...): sets the Web server debug log verbosity.

values.name: Web HTTP TRACE
values.description: Boolean/Integer: enables/disables the HTTP TRACE method.

values.name: Web HSTS enabled
values.description: Boolean/Integer: enables HTTP Strict Transport Security.

values.name: Web HSTS max age
values.description: Integer: HSTS max-age value (seconds).

values.name: Web HTTP enabled
values.description: Boolean/Integer: enables/disables plain HTTP.

values.name: Web HTTPS enabled
values.description: Boolean/Integer: enables/disables HTTPS.

values.name: Web scalable session
values.description: Boolean/Integer: enables scalable (multi-process-shared) Web sessions.

values.name: Web CORS enabled
values.description: Boolean/Integer: enables Cross-Origin Resource Sharing support.

values.name: Web CORS settings
values.description: Collection: CORS configuration objects.

values.name: Web Client IP address to listen
values.description: Text: client-facing IP address the Web server listens on.

WebDebugLogLevel.description: Sub-enum for WEB SET OPTION / WEB GET OPTION's value parameter when selector = Web debug log (84). XLIFF theme group 73, the 'wdl ...' constants.

values.name: wdl enable with all body parts

PrintOptionSelector.description: SET PRINT OPTION / GET PRINT OPTION option-selector constants (XLIFF theme group 47, 'Print Options'). Selects which printing option is read/modified; the shape/meaning of value1/value2 depends on which of these is passed.

values.name: Paper option
values.description: value1/value2 = paper width/height.

values.name: Orientation option
values.description: value1 only.

values.name: Destination option
values.description: value1 is one of the PrintDestinationTarget enum, value2 is a pathname.

values.name: Print preview option
values.description: value1 is one of the PrintPreviewMode enum.

PrintDestinationTarget.description: Sub-enum for SET PRINT OPTION / GET PRINT OPTION's value1 when option = Destination option (9). XLIFF theme group 47.

PrintPreviewMode.description: Sub-enum for SET PRINT OPTION / GET PRINT OPTION's value1 when option = Print preview option (18). XLIFF theme group 47. Note 'kp preview automatic' and 'kp preview none' are distinct named constants that both carry value 0.

DatabaseParameterSelector.description: Get/SET DATABASE PARAMETER selector constants (XLIFF theme group 37, 'Database Parameters'), restricted to the currently-active (non-deprecated) selectors; the group also contains legacy/obsolete selector names (XLIFF-marked with an '_o_' prefix, e.g. '_o_Seq order ratio') which are intentionally omitted here. The meaning/type/scope of the value parameter depends on which selector is passed; several selectors (Direct2D status, Diagnostic log level, Min TLS version, Times inside objects, Dates inside objects) have their own sub-enum of possible values.

values.name: Direct2D status
values.description: value is one of the Direct2DStatus enum.

values.name: Dates inside objects
values.description: value is one of the DatesInsideObjectsFormat enum.

values.name: Diagnostic log level
values.description: value is one of the DiagnosticLogLevel enum.

values.name: Min TLS version
values.description: value is one of the MinTlsVersion enum.

values.name: Times inside objects
values.description: value is one of the TimesInsideObjectsUnit enum.

Direct2DStatus.description: Sub-enum for Get/SET DATABASE PARAMETER's value when selector = Direct2D status (69). XLIFF theme group 37, active (non-'_o_') values only.

DiagnosticLogLevel.description: Sub-enum for Get/SET DATABASE PARAMETER's value when selector = Diagnostic log level (86). XLIFF theme group 37.

MinTlsVersion.description: Sub-enum for Get/SET DATABASE PARAMETER's value when selector = Min TLS version (105). XLIFF theme group 37, active (non-'_o_') values only.

TimesInsideObjectsUnit.description: Sub-enum for Get/SET DATABASE PARAMETER's value when selector = Times inside objects (109). XLIFF theme group 37.

DatesInsideObjectsFormat.description: Sub-enum for Get/SET DATABASE PARAMETER's value when selector = Dates inside objects (85). XLIFF theme group 37.

HierarchicalListItemSelector.description: SET LIST ITEM PARAMETER / GET LIST ITEM PARAMETER selector constants (XLIFF theme group 28, 'Hierarchical Lists'), active (non-'_o_') values only; the group also contains legacy resource-based constants (Ala Macintosh/Ala Windows/Use PICT resource/Use PicRef/node ids) which predate the current text-property-based API and are intentionally omitted here.

VersionTypeBitFlag.description: Version type's bit-field return-value constants (XLIFF theme group 5, '4D Environment'). The return value is a bit field (a version can be several of these simultaneously; combine with bitwise AND to test).

values.name: Demo version
values.description: Not available in current 4D versions.

values.name: Merged application
values.description: Version is an application merged with 4D Volume Desktop.
